
```{r build-supfig-montecarlo-meanabstrend}
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| out-width: "75%"
#| fig-width: 7.5

plot_trend <- tar_read(
    mc_summaries_meanabstrend_10000,
    store = store_in_pipeline()
)%>%
    split_community_id %>%
    mutate(
        HABITAT_GROUP = factor(HABITAT_GROUP, levels = c("woodland", "farmland", "built"))
    ) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = HABITAT_GROUP)) +
    geom_pointrange(
        aes(
        y = mean,
        ymin = lwr,
        ymax = upr,
        color =COMMUNITY_ID
    ), position = position_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.33), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_viridis_d() +
    labs(
        y = "Monte Carlo mean absolute trend",
        x = "Habitat category"
    ) +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

save_and_output(
    plot_trend,
    filename = here::here("output/Fig_S9.png"),
    width = 7.5,
    height = 0.618 * 7.5,
    unit = "in",
    bg = "white"
)
```
